title: kompli Result
description: Canonical result JSON emitted by `kompli audit` / `remediate`. This is the Phase 1 shape; per-rule `tags` and inline `metadata` are added when the unified benchmark-definition input lands (Phase 3), which is why additional properties are permitted at the top level and per rule.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the run started.

host.description: Provenance of the scanned host. Benchmark definitions are architecture-agnostic, so the arch/distribution a result was produced on is recorded here for multi-arch traceability.

arch.description: System architecture derived from DistributionInfo, e.g. "x86_64".

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the run in milliseconds.

status.description: Overall status, aggregated across rules with the engine's allOf three-valued logic: NonCompliant if any rule is NonCompliant; otherwise NotApplicable if any rule is NotApplicable, or if no rules were evaluated (empty benchmark or a section filter that matched nothing); otherwise Compliant.

rules.description: One entry per evaluated rule, in evaluation order.

indicators.description: The engine's step-by-step reasoning tree for the rule.

title.description: Human-readable rule title (the ResourceID; reuses the definition's field name).

id.description: The rule's sole externally-quoted identifier: the payload key remainder (opaque, unique within the benchmark file it was evaluated from - e.g. '1.1.1.1' for CIS, 'SV-260469' for STIG - see docs/payload-key-format.md). No separate UUID ruleId field - that lives only in the MOF now, still reconstructible from this id (UUID(sha256(full payload key))).

status.description: Per-rule status. Overall status is aggregated with the engine's allOf three-valued logic (CombineAllOf): NonCompliant dominates; otherwise NotApplicable propagates; otherwise Compliant.

parameters.description: Effective parameters (payload defaults merged with any user overrides).
